task.title: Protocol-safe reset auto-pickup and agency levels
task.summary: Implement CodeWiki reset auto-pickup from source-backed protocol-safe kickoff messages and add configurable task/sprint/roadmap agency levels that govern continuation.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki reset auto-picks up through a protocol-safe source-backed kickoff when configured agency level allows continuation; agency level task/sprint/roadmap controls approval cadence while hard gates remain mandatory.
acceptance: Same-session CodeWiki compaction delivers a minimal resume-context kickoff with auto turn triggering when safe.
Fresh-session resume seeds the replacement session with the same source-backed kickoff while preserving manual /wiki-resume UX.
Reset defers or refuses auto-pickup when pending tool/message state or adapter capability cannot guarantee a valid next-turn boundary.
No reset path injects slash-command text through follow-up chat or calls continuation from an assistant-role leaf.
Regression tests reproduce invalid assistant-leaf risk and prove safe kickoff/fallback behavior.
Config schema/defaults expose agency level, approval cadence, context reset auto-pickup, budgets, and hard stop gates.
Agency planner interprets task, sprint, and roadmap levels as continuation boundaries, not permission to bypass validation/risk/publication/destructive gates.
Status/config surfaces show effective agency level and reset auto-pickup policy.
Roadmap-level agency remains budgeted and stops on semantic decisions, validation blocks, artifact conflicts, risk escalation, publication/destructive actions, or unsafe reset boundaries.
non_goals: Do not implement parallel subagent orchestration unless already supported by existing agency machinery.
Do not grant automatic publication or remote push permission.
Do not publish or push changes.

exit_criteria: Regression tests cover protocol-safe kickoff/fallback and agency-level gates.
Fresh implementation validation starts from source refs and content proof.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Same-session CodeWiki compaction delivers a minimal resume-context kickoff with auto turn triggering when safe.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/adapters/pi/compaction.ts builds CodeWiki custom kickoff from buildCodewikiResumeContext and calls pi.sendMessage(summary.kickoff, { triggerTurn: true, deliverAs: "nextTurn" }) after compact onComplete; tests/smoke/codewiki-compaction.test.mjs asserts this path.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Fresh-session resume seeds the replacement session with the same source-backed kickoff while preserving manual /wiki-resume UX.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/adapters/pi/commands/resume.ts uses buildCodewikiResumeKickoff for --new replacement sessions and sends it through replacementCtx.sendMessage(... triggerTurn nextTurn), with sendUserMessage fallback using kickoff content; tests/smoke/resume-scheduler.test.mjs asserts this path.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Reset defers or refuses auto-pickup when pending tool/message state or adapter capability cannot guarantee a valid next-turn boundary.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: evaluateCodewikiResetLifecycleBoundary blocks non-idle or pending-message states; evaluateCodewikiAutoPickupBoundary refuses missing custom-message capability or disabled auto-pickup; codewiki-compaction smoke covers pending and missing-adapter cases.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: No reset path injects slash-command text through follow-up chat or calls continuation from an assistant-role leaf.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: Compaction and fresh-resume tests assert no /wiki-resume sendUserMessage injection and no assistant-role continuation leaves in reset code paths.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Regression tests reproduce invalid assistant-leaf risk and prove safe kickoff/fallback behavior.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: tests/smoke/codewiki-compaction.test.mjs and tests/smoke/resume-scheduler.test.mjs include source and boundary assertions for custom kickoff, next-turn trigger, fallback refusal, and no assistant leaf/slash injection.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Config schema/defaults expose agency level, approval cadence, context reset auto-pickup, budgets, and hard stop gates.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/agency/types.ts defines AgencyConfig/EffectiveAgencyPolicy with level, approval_cadence, context_reset, budgets, parallelism, stop_gates; src/project/templates.ts and .codewiki/config.json include defaults.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Agency planner interprets task, sprint, and roadmap levels as continuation boundaries, not permission to bypass validation/risk/publication/destructive gates.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/agency/planning.ts computes hard stop reasons from approval boundaries, artifact conflicts, health/validation blocks, semantic decisions, and risk escalation; tests/smoke/resume-scheduler.test.mjs asserts agency level continuation semantics and planner stop-gate surfacing.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Status/config surfaces show effective agency level and reset auto-pickup policy.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: src/state/builders.ts adds effective policy into status state and direction; src/adapters/pi/ui/manager.ts and src/adapters/pi/ui/theme.ts display agency level, approval cadence, and reset auto-pickup in status/config surfaces.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Roadmap-level agency remains budgeted and stops on semantic decisions, validation blocks, artifact conflicts, risk escalation, publication/destructive actions, or unsafe reset boundaries.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: EffectiveAgencyPolicy preserves configured budgets and mandatory stop_gates including semantic_decision, validation_block, artifact_conflict, risk_escalation, publication, destructive_action, unsafe_reset_boundary; agency planning exposes gates and blocks work-mode continuation on detected hard stops.
